desc: The San Diego County coastal town that served as To The Stars Academy's corporate base, including the brick-and-mortar store operated by the Entertainment Division as recorded in the company's Form 1-K. It is the physical counterpart to the Pentagon in this domain: the address at which a former Skunk Works program director, a retired CIA Senior Intelligence Service officer, and a man who had just resigned from OUSD(I) were all, briefly, employees of the same small California company.
